title: StockSmart Inventory Planning Standard — Customer-Owned Fill-To Level of a Bin Converted from Consignment
content:
Under the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program, a bin whose slow-moving consigned item Corbett withdraws at a par review is converted to customer-owned replenishment, and its customer-owned fill-to level is set as below.

**1. The converted item and its bin.** The converted item is the item of the program's most recent consignment withdrawal, and its bin is the bin whose entries carry that item; where two or more consignment withdrawals carry that most recent date, or there is none, no fill-to level is set under this standard.

**2. Which withdrawals are conversions.** A consignment withdrawal counts as a par-review conversion only where the converted item's bin carries no removal entry and the program is not closed; after a withdrawal that follows the removal of the bin or the end of the program, no fill-to level is set under this standard.

**3. The twelve-month window.** A row's age in whole months is the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month; the last twelve months hold rows of age below twelve.

**4. The inputs.** The weekly draw of the converted item is its consumption billed over the last twelve months divided by 52. The storeroom cover is 2 weeks, no further cover weeks are added (0 weeks) and the limit share is the whole, 1.

**5. The fill-to level.** The customer-owned fill-to level is the weekly draw times the cover in weeks, which is the storeroom cover plus every added cover week, times the limit share, taken to six decimal places and then rounded up to the next whole unit.

### Worked figures (hypothetical items)

| Consumption billed, last twelve months | Weekly draw | Cover in weeks | Limit share | Product to six decimals | Fill-to level |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 520 units | 10.000000 | 2 | 1 | 20.000000 | 20 |
| 300 units | 5.769231 | 2 | 1 | 11.538462 | 12 |
| 26 units | 0.500000 | 2 | 1 | 1.000000 | 1 |

### Points of judgement

- The item is read from the program's withdrawal history, not from the customer's description of the bin.
- A withdrawal booked when the bin was removed, or when the program ended, does not make a converted bin under point 2.
